control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on TX-8001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-8001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-8001 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 9 March 2023 a corrective action on TX-8001 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
